registration.selection: unchanged static DEV_MODEL UniqueValid + .05*Valid every500; original best and last preserved; TRAIN closure audit cannot reselect
registration.comparison_scope: A genuinely K2-trained conventional saturation baseline, not a new joint-risk objective. Same historical K4 updates/batch/lr/width/depth/data; half its generated/gradient path slots. Candidate count and query parameter count differ, so not a same-path-budget K4 comparison or an initialization-matched pair.
registration.cpu_policy: Launcher pins itself and all descendants to one allowed logical CPU, with explicit taskset on recorded subprocesses. OMP_NUM_THREADS=4 and historical trainer requests four torch threads, but affinity restricts actual CPU execution to one logical core. Do not compare CPU wall-time fairly against historical four-core runs.
registration.post_training: CPU TRAIN768 all-present single-closure audit with exact same prior reference controls. No changed evaluator, no new constraint condition, no DEV closure evaluation.
registration.research_decision: Geometric selection already reaches the response upper bound. This run only tests ordinary learned small-budget behavior, regardless of its score; it cannot establish joint-risk innovation.

config.interventions: Every present opening closed independently, including closure of the final opening. No model recomputation after closure.

candidate_accounting.joint4_actual: 4 complete generated paths from one real K4-trained forward
candidate_accounting.joint4_prefix2_zero_adaptation: first 2 retained from the same 4 generated paths; charged 4, not a trained K2 baseline
candidate_accounting.reference_farthest_k2: privileged stored bank of R complete reference paths examined; 2 selected before closure; max C(R,2) pair checks, not K2 generation
candidate_accounting.reference_geometric_dpp_k2: same R bank, unit-quality RBF K2 MAP is exactly farthest pair; not an independent replication
candidate_accounting.reference_response_oracle_k2: same R bank and every closure outcome from exact privileged geometry; optimal fixed pair over all solvable closures; diagnostic upper bound within reference bank only

config.screening_rule: 5pp equal-parent AnyValid opportunity is only a cheap TRAIN falsification screen. Gap beyond geometric reference selection is principal; gap only versus unadapted prefix cannot support a new mechanism. Any retained opportunity requires a genuinely K2-trained saturation baseline before deciding a mechanism comparison.
config.reference_scope: complete finite opening-pair representatives in controlled geometry; not enumeration of all continuous trajectories or evidence about incomplete robot demonstrations
config.selection_ties: stable original reference-index lexicographic order; one pair selected per parent before a particular closure is revealed
config.no_solution_handling: Retain every closure and report its raw count, all-closure metric, and separate solvable-only equal-parent denominator; no fabricated failed learning target. Parents with zero solvable closures remain with null conditional metrics.

original_audit_provenance.data_access: split/parent/scene IDs are metadata; only TRAIN payload rows decoded, DEV bytes may be skipped by ZIP decompression; locked-containing archive rejected before any payload

trained_config.supervision: same full positive reference pool; matching objective differs
